description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the 'OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter' within the OpenMRS project. It verifies that certain beans are excluded when specific modules are started, by asserting that an exception is thrown if the bean is not found in the application context.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilterWithModulesTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to verify module exclusion behavior based on application context and profile filters.

methods.name: match_shouldNotIncludeBeanIfModuleIsStarted
methods.description: Test method that verifies the 'match' method in 'OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter' correctly excludes beans when a module is started by asserting a 'NoSuchBeanDefinitionException' is thrown when attempting to retrieve the bean.
